widgets_values: The image is a charming storybook cover and diorama scene featuring a handcrafted clay badger baker standing outside a tiny rustic bakery, designed in an earthy, warm palette: terracotta brick, buttery golden pastry crust, soft sage green woodwork, flour-dusted white, and evening twilight periwinkle, illuminated by warm lantern light pouring from the bakery window and overhead golden hour rays. The badger is the hero, sculpted from matte polymer clay with visible, delightful fingerprint textures and fine wooden tool marks along his fur; he wears a slightly wrinkled blue linen apron dusted with white chalky flour and tiny round wire spectacles balanced on his sculpted snout. He stands proud on short stout legs, holding a wooden baker's peel loaded with three freshly baked, braided golden brioche loaves. Surrounding the entrance, the scene is lively and meticulously crafted: the bakery window has curved sage-green wooden frames displaying tiny clay croissants, red-glazed fruit tarts, and stacked miniature sourdough rounds; to the left, a sleeping calico cat sculpted from clay curls atop a burlap sack labeled with a tiny stitched grain emblem; a wrought-iron lantern hangs by the oak door, casting a radial warm glow across cobblestones where scattered fallen golden leaves lie. Floating in the soft evening sky above the roof are three sculpted paper-cutout clouds on thin wires, accompanied by small golden four-point foil stars. The typography is integrated as tactile signage: mounted above the bakery door, an arched wooden sign is carved with raised cream lettering that reads "THE CRUMB & HEARTH"; directly below it, painted on the glass in bouncy hand-lettered script, is "ARTISAN SOURDOUGH". Stamped into the cream border across the bottom of the cover in bold rustic capitals is "A BAKER'S TALE", flanked at the lower right by four neat stacked lines reading "FRESH BREAD", "WARM HEARTH", "DAILY BAKE", and "SPRING FEAST". All lettering is English only, with no Chinese characters anywhere on the cover, and every clay surface shows soft natural ambient occlusion and realistic matte depth.
